name: Firebase Studio
summary: Web-based full-stack app development workspace with Gemini.
description: Firebase Studio is Google's entirely web-based workspace for building full-stack and mobile apps with Gemini assistance, Open VSX extensions, web previews and Android emulators. It integrates directly with Firebase App Hosting for deployment and monitoring. It is currently available at no cost during preview with 3 workspaces, and members of the Google Developer Program get up to 30 workspaces.
